title: LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds
summary: Bitcoin Magazine LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds LNbits released version 1.7.0 on November 10 as an urgent security update following active attacks that began November 8. Operators must upgrade before restarting servers as prior versions put funds at risk of theft. This post LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .
